summary: Retain payment idempotency keys for 72 hours
rationale: Acme Bank retries failed callbacks for up to 72 hours after an outage; shorter TTLs caused the Feb 18 duplicate credits.
Acme drops the statement file around 01:30 IST and Finance needs the ledger closed by 06:00; midnight runs used partial files.

summary: Reconcile on bank reference first, then amount with ±1 minor-unit FX tolerance
rationale: Acme rounds FX conversions half-up while the ledger uses banker's rounding, so exact amount matching flags false mismatches.

summary: Keep accepting Acme's HMAC-SHA1 webhook signatures until their v2 cutover
rationale: Acme's SHA-256 signer slipped to Q1 2027; v1 stays enabled behind the acme_hmac_v1 flag, for Acme only.

summary: Enforce Idempotency-Key headers at the API gateway
rationale: Reject duplicate POSTs at the edge instead of in every service.

summary: Use frictionless 3-D Secure for card payments under ₹2,000
rationale: Cuts checkout drop-off on small tickets while fraud rules still score every payment.

summary: Emit ledger events through a transactional outbox
rationale: Deploys were dropping events, which made reconciliation report phantom mismatches.

summary: Keep CI on self-hosted runners inside the PCI network
rationale: Hosted runners would pull the deploy pipeline into PCI audit scope.

summary: Limit card attempts to 5 cards per device per 24 hours
rationale: Card-testing attacks in June used 6–12 cards per device; 5 blocks them without hurting families sharing a phone.

summary: Recognise month-end revenue on settlement date, not capture date
rationale: Auditors asked revenue to follow when funds actually settle at Acme.

summary: Clear the stale settlement lock, then resume the batch instead of re-running
Re-run the flaky test_concurrent_capture_refund job without random ordering
Strip the BOM and CRLFs from Acme's month-end statement before import
Replay 24h of ledger events into recon after a ledger deploy
Reset Tailscale when the staging VPN drops
Prune the Docker layer cache when CI runners run out of disk
Do a rolling restart after changing Kong plugins; reload is not enough
Run the finance snapshot with --full-refresh on the 1st when Acme files are late
Disable pg_cron before restoring the staging snapshot or jobs double-fire
